# AcdyOn - Global Executive Learning Ecosystem

AcdyOn provides premium executive education, AI mastery, doctoral pathways, and honorary recognition for ambitious professionals and global leaders.

## Key Links
- [Home](https://acdyonlandingpage.vercel.app/)
- [Programs](https://acdyonlandingpage.vercel.app/programs)
- [Doctoral Pathways](https://acdyonlandingpage.vercel.app/doctoral)
- [Universities & Recognition](https://acdyonlandingpage.vercel.app/universities)
- [Contact & Consultation](https://acdyonlandingpage.vercel.app/book-consultation)

## Technical Architecture
This site is built with Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS, and React Three Fiber for the 3D scroll experiences.
